title: Apex Legends Takeover Patch Notes
key_update: Support perk reduced; Assault class reworked; Crypto EMP and Mad Maggie Wrecking Ball can counter Gibraltar Dome; Mad Maggie can counter Newcastle Mobile Shield; Arsenals added for weapon access.
portfolio_interpretation: Post-Championship response targeted the Support/reset/defensive-shell system rather than treating Gibraltar, Newcastle, or shotguns as isolated balance issues.

title: Announcing Year 5 of the Apex Legends Global Series
key_update: Legend Bans introduced for Year 5 series; most-picked legend after each match is removed for the remainder of the series, with class-protection rules if an entire class would be removed.
portfolio_interpretation: ALGS moved beyond numerical balance and used tournament rules to limit composition convergence, forcing teams to prepare fallback comps and improving tactical variety.

title: Announcing Year 5 of the Apex Legends Global Series
key_update: Broken Moon added to the ALGS Year 5 map pool alongside World's Edge, Storm Point, and E-District.
portfolio_interpretation: Map-pool expansion is another operations lever: it changes rotation, resource planning, and endgame terrain without directly nerfing a legend or weapon.
